# Best home backup power stations under $1,000

**My pick: Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 (about $900).** It has 2,048 Wh, 2,400 W output and a 10 ms UPS switchover, and you can add a battery pack later to reach 4 kWh. Outage Authority estimates about 23 hours for a fridge, CPAP and router together. [Outage Authority roundup](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Most battery per dollar | Bluetti Elite 200 V2 (2,074 Wh, 2,600 W) | $899 (price disputed, see below) | 6,000-cycle LiFePO4, but it can't be expanded. [Outage Outfitter](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/) |
| Budget | [Bluetti AC180](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180) (1,152 Wh, 1,800 W) | $499, or $474.05 with code AFF5OFF | Best Wh per dollar under $500, 5-year warranty. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/bluetti-ac180) |
| Lightest | Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 (1,070 Wh, 23.8 lb) | $489 at Outbound Power | About 12 hours of fridge, CPAP and router. Jackery's own store now charges $559. [Outage Authority review](https://outageauthority.com/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2) |
| Cheapest 1.5 kWh | Anker SOLIX F1500 (1,536 Wh) | $599.99 | Flagged "unusually low" on price. It's an older model. [Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/) |

The EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max (2,048 Wh, $899) and Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 ($899) are also solid at the same size. Both are listed in the [Outage Outfitter ranking](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/).

## Things to know

- **The Elite 200 V2 price is inconsistent.** Two sources list $899, but Outage Authority says Bluetti ended its promotion and the price returned to $1,199. It also saw Amazon at $798.99 on Oct 7. Check the live price before buying. At $1,199 it's over budget, and the Anker is the better buy.
- **Match the size to your outage.** About 1 kWh covers an overnight outage for a fridge, CPAP and router. For multi-day outages, or anything with a window AC, choose the 2 kWh class.
- **None of these run a whole house.** Well pumps and central AC need 240 V units, which cost far more than $1,000.
- **The reviews are spec-based, not lab-tested.** Most of these sites earn affiliate commissions, though they say it doesn't change their rankings.

The search results didn't include a direct purchase link for the Anker C2000 Gen 2, so I can't give you a verified one. The Outage Authority roundup above links to its Amazon listing. The BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 is also listed at [Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/p/337557774) for $499, but it's currently out of stock.

If you tell me what you need to run (fridge, CPAP, window AC) and for how long, I can narrow this to one pick.
